{"code": "from pandas.api.types import CategoricalDtype

# Define ordered categories for severity
category_order = ['mild', 'moderate', 'severe']

# Convert severity to categorical with order
df['severity_cat'] = df['severity'].astype(severity_cat)

# Cross-tabulate sex vs severity to check balance
cross_sex_severity = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity'], margins=True)
